scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r run build && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.test:egovchain: postman collection run postman/eGov-hackathon.postman_collection.json --environment .local/postman/eGov-hackathon.local.postman_environment.json -i '09 - eGovChain - chain ID' -i '10 - eGovChain - latest block' --bail failure
